issue.title: Pressing backspace with mini.completion crashes on Nightly

repository.name: mini.nvim
repository.description: Library of 40+ independent Lua modules improving Neovim experience with minimal effort

issue.body:
### Contributing guidelines

- [x] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [x] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version of the `main` branch

### Module(s)

mini.completion

### Neovim version

0.12 (!at least latest Nightly build!)

### Description

When using mini.completion after https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/34247/commits/9bfd0162dc11478febbdfd0fd9c9c880a0f454ae, nvim crashes after pressing backspace while completion is active.

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/34247 Introduced a way to specify completion functions from the complete option, maybe this is relevant for mini.completion?

### Reproduction

1. Create separate 'nvim-repro' config directory:
    - '~/.config/nvim-repro/' on Unix
    - '~/AppData/Local/nvim-repro/' on Windows

2. Inside 'nvim-repro' directory create a file named 'init.lua'.
   Populate it with the following content:

```lua
-- Clone latest 'mini.nvim' (requires Git CLI installed)
vim.cmd('echo "Installing `mini.nvim`" | redraw')
local mini_path = vim.fn.stdpath("data") .. "/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim"
local clone_cmd = { "git", "clone", "--depth=1", "https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim", mini_path }
vim.fn.system(clone_cmd)
vim.cmd('echo "`mini.nvim` is installed" | redraw')

-- Make sure 'mini.nvim' is available
vim.cmd("packadd mini.nvim")
require("mini.deps").setup()

-- Add extra setup steps needed to reproduce the behavior
require("mini.notify").setup()
vim.notify = MiniNotify.make_notify()

vim.lsp.config("lua_ls", {
	cmd = { "/home/jonas/.local/share/nvim/mason/bin/lua-language-server" },
	filetypes = { "lua" },
	name = "lua_ls",
	root_markers = {
		".luarc.json",
		".luarc.jsonc",
		".luacheckrc",
		".stylua.toml",
		"stylua.toml",
		"selene.toml",
		"selene.yml",
		".git",
	},
})
vim.lsp.enable("lua_ls")

MiniDeps.add("folke/lazydev.nvim")
require("lazydev").setup()

require("mini.completion").setup()

vim.o.completeopt = "menuone,fuzzy,noinsert"
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("LspAttach", {
	group = vim.api.nvim_create_augroup("default-lsp-attach", { clear = true }),
	callback = function(event)
		local client = vim.lsp.get_client_by_id(event.data.client_id)
		if not client then
			return
		end
	end,
})
 ```

3. Run `NVIM_APPNAME=nvim-repro nvim` (i.e. execute `nvim` with `NVIM_APPNAME` environment variable set to "nvim-repro").
   Wait for all dependencies to install.

4. Run `NVIM_APPNAME=nvim-repro nvim someFile.lua` and start typing  until the completion popup appears. `vim.api.nvim_` works pretty well.

5. Press backspace, nvim crashes!

body:
```vim
let g:do_complete = v:false
func Omni_test(findstart, base)
  if a:findstart
    let g:do_complete = !g:do_complete
  endif
  if g:do_complete
    return a:findstart ? 0 : [#{word: a:base .. 'def'}, #{word: a:base .. 'ghi'}]
  endif
  return a:findstart ? -3 : {}
endfunc
set omnifunc=Omni_test
set completeopt=menuone,fuzzy,noinsert
call setline(1, 'abc')
call feedkeys("A\<C-X>\<C-O>\<BS>\<Esc>0", 'tx!')
```
From a rough look this seems to fix the problem:
```diff
diff --git a/src/nvim/insexpand.c b/src/nvim/insexpand.c
index 19bfd726e4..987fce5243 100644
--- a/src/nvim/insexpand.c
+++ b/src/nvim/insexpand.c
@@ -1339,7 +1339,8 @@ static int cp_compare_nearest(const void *a, const void *b)
 /// Set fuzzy score.
 static void set_fuzzy_score(void)
 {
-  if (compl_leader.data != NULL && compl_leader.size > 0) {
+  if (compl_leader.data != NULL && compl_leader.size > 0
+      && compl_first_match != NULL) {
     compl_T *comp = compl_first_match;
     do {
       comp->cp_score = fuzzy_match_str(comp->cp_str.data, compl_leader.data);
```

issue.title: Crash when pressing backspace with fuzzy completion
issue.body:
Problem:  Crash when pressing backspace with fuzzy completion.
Solution: Don't dereference compl_first_match when it's NULL.

related: neovim/neovim#34419

issue.title: vim-patch:9.1.{1447,1449}

issue.body:
Fix #34419

#### vim-patch:9.1.1447: completion: crash when backspacing with fuzzy completion

Problem:  completion: crash when backspacing with fuzzy completion
Solution: Don't dereference compl_first_match when it's NULL
          (zeertzjq).

closes: vim/vim#17511

https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/91782b4aeb62043739138903f30cad2fe79238ab


#### vim-patch:9.1.1449: typo in pum_display()

Problem:  typo in pum_display()
Solution: update the comment, remove empty new lines
          (glepnir)

closes: vim/vim#17506

https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/ed4eb74f7a8eb47ff9f4dbba395fee9662c226d6
